content.description: Since its February 2021 launch, Mimo has positioned itself as a bridge between DeFi and the euro-denominated fiat world. Users can deposit assets into vaults, mint PAR, and exchange currencies directly on the platform, enabling straightforward interactions between digital assets and euro-denominated value. Developers can access analytics offered by Mimo to study how the system is used, track asset flows, and evaluate performance across the protocol.
content.meta: Mimo is a DeFi application. Discover Mimo and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
